examples.title: antibody CDR design against IL-13
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/sample/antibody -F antigen=@antigen.pdb -F framework=@framework.pdb -F antigen_chain=C -F heavy_chain=A -F light_chain=B -F 'specified_hotspots=C11,C14,C15,C101,C107,C108' -F 'cdr_length=CDRH1,8-8,CDRH2,8-8,CDRH3,10-20,CDRL1,6-9,CDRL2,3-3,CDRL3,9-11' -F samples_per_target=5 -F name=1IJZ_IL13

examples.title: basic binder against IL7Ra target
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/sample/binder -F target=@target.pdb -F target_chain=B -F binder_chain=A -F 'specified_hotspots=B119,B141,B200' -F samples_min_length=75 -F samples_max_length=120 -F samples_per_target=5 -F name=IL7Ra
examples.notes: Mirrors the upstream README example. Output PDBs land in output/IL7Ra/*.pdb.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

tool_outputs.note: Binder outputs are flat under `output/` with files named `<name>_<idx>.pdb` plus `sample_metrics.csv`.  The other four modes nest under `output/<name>/`.  Use GET /api/jobs/{id}/files to enumerate, or /file/{relpath} for one.

input_uri_schemes.upload: multipart/form-data file fields (target_pdb / antigen_pdb / framework_pdb / motif_csv).
input_uri_schemes.job://<id>/<file>: Re-use a file from a prior ppiflow job (same NAS).
input_uri_schemes.file:///abs/path: Direct NAS path; works across services on the shared mount.
input_uri_schemes.oss://<bucket>/<key>: Alibaba Cloud OSS object (needs OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / _SECRET env vars).
Generic URL, including OSS signed URLs.

weights.monomer: checkpoint/monomer.ckpt (used by both monomer + scaffolding endpoints)
weights.note: Baked into the Docker image. Missing files log a warning; the subprocess will then fail with a clearer message.

config_tips.cdr_length: Comma-separated `CDR<name>,min-max,...`. Antibody must include all six CDRs (CDRH1-3 + CDRL1-3); nanobody covers heavy only (CDRH1-3). Defaults are upstream's recommendations.
config_tips.length_subset: Monomer endpoint takes a JSON list of target lengths. PPIFlow samples `samples_per_target` structures at each length.
config_tips.specified_hotspots: Format `<chain><resnum>,<chain><resnum>,...` (e.g. `B119,B141,B200`). Omitting it puts PPIFlow into random hotspot sampling via `sample_hotspot_rate_{min,max}`.
config_tips.framework_pdb: Antibody/nanobody only. CDR loops must already be removed and IMGT numbering applied. See PPIFlow README for preprocessing.

service_specific.not_in_scope_v0_0_1: Partial-flow redesign (sample_*_partial.py) is not exposed in v0.0.1. Sequence design (ProteinMPNN/AbMPNN), packing (Flowpacker), scoring (AF3Score), and Rosetta steps live in their own bioagent services.
